Package org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer

Class ExpressionEditor

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer.ExpressionEditor
public class ExpressionEditor extends Object
The editing state of an expression in the logic programmer, together with the edit actions that are applied identically on client and server.

    • parseValue

      @Nullable public static IValue parseValue(IValueType<?> expectedType, String text)
      Parse the given text to a value for the given expected type. Numbers and booleans are read as in the text of an expression, such as 5L, and otherwise the text is read as the element of the type in the logic programmer reads it.
      Parameters:
      expectedType - The expected type, possibly a category.
      text - The text.
      Returns:
      The parsed value, or null if it could not be parsed.

    • isTextEditable

      public static boolean isTextEditable(IValueType<?> type)
      Parameters:
      type - A value type.
      Returns:
      If constants of this type can be entered as text: those whose element in the logic programmer is text or a checkbox, and the categories of numbers, booleans or strings.
